request: In the WPS Register (WPS No, Process, Thickness Min, Thickness Max, Remark) write Range? in Remark for every WPS where Thickness Min or Thickness Max is blank or not a number, or where the minimum is bigger than the maximum, and clear the Remark on the others. Tell me how many I marked.

List on an Open Points sheet every point of the ITP Tracker (ITP No, Point, Inspection Status, Planned Date) that is not Closed, the earliest Planned Date first, with the same headings. Points with no Planned Date go at the end. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

A dispatch readiness tool, started with one macro. (1) In the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Status, Dispatch Flag) write Dispatched in Dispatch Flag for every job that has a row with an Actual Date in the Dispatch sheet (Dispatch No, Job ID, Planned Date, Actual Date), Ready for every other job whose Status is Complete, and clear it on the rest. (2) On a Ready To Ship sheet list the Ready jobs with the same headings, Job IDs A to Z. (3) On a Customer Dispatches sheet write each Customer with how many of its jobs are Dispatched, customers A to Z. (4) Tell me how many jobs are Ready. Job IDs are typed with stray spaces and in mixed case. The output sheets are rebuilt every run.

In the Calibration Tracker (Instrument ID, Type, Range Max, Reading Max, Remark) write Over range in Remark where Reading Max is bigger than Range Max, Check where either of them is blank or not a number, and clear the Remark on the others. The numbers are sometimes typed as text. Tell me how many are Over range.

In the Material Certs sheet (Heat No, MTC No, Grade, Received Date) highlight the whole row yellow when MTC No is blank and the Received Date is more than 14 days ago. Clear old row highlights first so it can be run again, and tell me how many rows I highlighted.

In the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Status, Percent Complete, Flag) write Check status in Flag when Percent Complete is 100 but the Status is not Complete, or the Status is Complete but Percent Complete is below 100. Clear the Flag on the others, add the Flag heading if it is missing, and tell me how many jobs I flagged.

In the ITP Tracker (ITP No, Point, Inspection Status, Inspector, Remark) write No inspector in Remark for every Closed point whose Inspector is blank, and clear the Remark on the others. Closed is typed in any case and with stray spaces. Tell me how many points have no inspector.

From the Calibration Tracker (Instrument ID, Location, Next Calibration Due) make a Location Due sheet with each Location, how many instruments it has and how many of them are overdue, locations A to Z. Instruments with no Location are ignored; one with no due date is counted but is not overdue. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

From the Consumable Issue log (Issue No, Issue Date, Filler Class, Qty Issued) make a Recent Usage sheet with each Filler Class and its total Qty Issued over the last 30 days, the biggest total first. Filler classes are typed in mixed case. Ignore rows with no class, no real Issue Date or a Qty Issued that is not a number. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

From the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Status) make a Status Count sheet with each Status and its number of jobs, the most first, and a last row Total with all the jobs counted. 'closed' and 'Closed ' are the same status; a job with no Status is counted as Blank. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

From the Material Certs sheet (Heat No, Supplier, Grade) make a Supplier Grades sheet with one row for each supplier and grade that appear together and the number of certificates, suppliers A to Z. Supplier and grade are matched ignoring case and stray spaces. Rows with no supplier or no grade are ignored. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

Check the Dispatch sheet (Dispatch No, Job ID, Planned Date, Job Check) against the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Status). In the Dispatch sheet write Unknown job in Job Check when the Job ID is not in the Job Tracker, Job closed when that job's Status is Closed, and clear it on the others. Job IDs differ in case and stray spaces. Add the heading if it's missing, and tell me how many need a look.

Check the ITP Tracker (ITP No, Point, Instrument ID, Cal Check) against the Calibration Tracker (Instrument ID, Next Calibration Due). In the ITP Tracker write Out of cal in Cal Check when the point's instrument is overdue, Unknown instrument when it isn't in the Calibration Tracker, and clear it on the others. Points with no Instrument ID are left alone. Tell me how many points need a look.

Compare the Material Certs sheet (Heat No, MTC No, GRN Check) with the GRN sheet (GRN No, Part No, Heat No). In Material Certs write Not received in GRN Check for every heat that is on no GRN line, and the number of GRN lines for the others. Heat numbers differ in case and stray spaces. Add the heading if it's missing, and tell me how many heats were not received.

In the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Status) make every Job ID trimmed and upper case, with any run of spaces inside it made one space ('job  101 ' becomes 'JOB 101'). Change nothing else and tell me how many cells I changed.

In the Calibration Tracker (Instrument ID, Next Calibration Due, Remark) some due dates were typed as text like 15/03/2026 (day first). Turn each of those into a real date, write Bad date in Remark for a text due date that isn't a real day-first date, and leave real dates and blank cells alone. Tell me how many dates I converted.

In the Cal Certs folder (a folder path I give the macro) each certificate is a PDF named after its instrument, like PG-104.pdf. For every row of the Calibration Tracker (Instrument ID, Cert Status) write Found in Cert Status when that instrument has a PDF there and Missing when not; a row with no Instrument ID gets nothing. Never change a file. Tell me how many are Missing.

For every job in the Job Tracker (Job ID, Status, Folder) that is not Closed, make a folder named after the Job ID inside the Jobs folder (a folder path I give the macro), with a Drawings folder inside it. Write Made, Already there or Bad name in Folder; leave Folder empty for Closed jobs. Never delete or overwrite anything.

In the Consumable Stock sheet (Batch No, Qty On Hand, Reorder Level, Reorder) put a formula in the Reorder column for every data row that shows YES when Qty On Hand is at or below Reorder Level and stays blank otherwise. Excel 2016 only.

Add a sheet called NCR Stats to the workbook if it isn't there yet. In A1 write Open NCRs and in B1 put a formula that counts how many cells of the Status column in the NCR sheet (NCR No, Status) read Open, so it stays right when the NCR sheet changes. Running it again must not add a second sheet.
On the Material Certs sheet (Heat No, MTC No, Supplier) find the heat number I give the macro and write its MTC No in cell F1, or Not found when the heat isn't there. Tell me the row it is on, or 0.

A job quality tool, started with one macro. (1) In the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Status, Open NCRs) write in Open NCRs how many Open NCRs each job has in the NCR Register (NCR No, Job ID, Status), 0 when none. (2) On a Jobs On Hold sheet list the jobs that are not Closed and have at least one Open NCR, with the same headings, the most NCRs first. (3) On an Unmatched NCRs sheet list the NCRs whose Job ID is not in the Job Tracker, with the NCR Register's headings. (4) Tell me how many jobs are on hold. Job IDs differ in case and stray spaces. The output sheets are rebuilt every run.
